name: FX Regression - EURGBP Donchian Risk Unit
description: Donchian breakout with ATR-based risk_unit sizing on EUR/GBP. Cross pair test: fxRate = GBP/USD rate. Includes GBP/USD for FX rate resolution.
source:
# Donchian Breakout - EURGBP with risk_unit sizing
# Cross pair: fxRate = GBPUSD (independent of EURGBP price)
# GBP/USD included for FX rate resolution

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# 20-day Donchian Channel
donchian = donchian_channel(window=20)(src.h, src.l)
upper_band = donchian.donchian_upper
lower_band = donchian.donchian_lower

# Lag by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead
upper_prior = upper_band >> 1
lower_prior = lower_band >> 1

# 5-day ATR for stop distance
atr5 = atr(period=5)(src.h, src.l, src.c)
stop_dist = 3 * atr5

# Entry: breakout above prior Donchian upper
# Exit: breakdown below prior Donchian lower
entry_signal = close > upper_prior
exit_signal = close < lower_prior
held = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# Long-only
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Risk-based sizing: 2% equity risk, stop at 3x ATR(5)
risk_unit()(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# Trailing stop protection
trailing_stop()(distance=stop_dist)
